For the main title "CHIMIE DES COMPLEXES":

Category: Serif/Roman
Subtype: Slab Serif (Egyptian)
Explanation: The typeface features thick, block-like serifs with very little contrast between the thick and thin strokes, characteristic of the Slab Serif style popular in 19th and early 20th-century academic and industrial printing.

For the secondary text (e.g., "INTRODUCTION", "PARIS"):

Category: Serif/Roman
Subtype: Old Style / Transitional
Explanation: These sections use a more traditional Roman face with moderate contrast and bracketed serifs, typical of standard book typography of the era.
